summary: Early but real: strong, quantified pain and a genuine Series-B compelling event give this deal a spine. It is fragile where it counts — single-threaded on Sam, economic buyer unconfirmed, decision and paper process unmapped, and no calendared next step. Multi-thread to Finance/Ops and lock a next meeting before this cools.

dimensions.rationale: Top priority (data trust / single source of truth) is named in the buyer's words and tied to 15 hrs/week plus board-level stakes; dollar impact is still a gut estimate, not a model.

risks.title: Single-threaded on one contact
risks.detail: The entire deal rests on Sam. Finance (likely economic buyer) and Operations are unengaged. One quiet week and this stalls.

risks.title: No next step on the calendar
risks.detail: The deal has no scheduled next interaction — the most common cause of early-stage slippage.

risks.title: Economic buyer unconfirmed
risks.detail: Finance must approve but has not been identified or met.

recommended_actions.action: Send Sam a short, stakeholder-ready summary framed on the board-prep angle and get the next meeting on the calendar with Finance + Operations invited.
recommended_actions.why: Fixes the two highest-severity risks at once (single-thread + no next step).

recommended_actions.action: Co-build a defensible ROI number (loaded analyst cost + cost of bad decisions) Sam can take to the board.
recommended_actions.why: Converts strong-but-soft impact into a CFO-ready business case.

recommended_actions.action: Map the decision and paper process: approvers, criteria, security/legal, and whether budget is allocated for this fiscal year.
recommended_actions.why: Removes the late-stage surprises that kill Series-B-timed deals.
